summary.title: Osborne runs hundreds of family shareholders and four generations of shareholders with Sttok

texts: Osborne is a family group founded in 1772 in El Puerto de Santa María. From its cellars it takes wines, brandies and Spanish gastronomy around the world, with brands such as Cinco Jotas and Montecillo.
Several hundred family shareholders and four generations of shareholders at once: every branch, every holding and every meeting must be in perfect order.
